[Add to Claude](https://seedtable.com/connect/claude) ![Fluxco logo](https://seedtable.com/api/logo/own/68e22a8c7ba8981925028caa8ec908dc.svg) # Fluxco [#3627startup in United Statesof 34,422](https://seedtable.com/g/usa "Ranked 3627 of 34,422 by Seedtable score — view the full ranking") [Hardware & Semiconductors](https://seedtable.com/best-hardware-startups) ·[Energy](https://seedtable.com/best-energy-startups) ·[Logistics & Supply Chain](https://seedtable.com/best-logistics-startups)[Website](https://fluxco.com/ "Website")[Register free to view this company's LinkedIn](https://seedtable.com/login?callbackUrl=/companies/fluxco "Register free to view this company's LinkedIn")18views· 60d [Updated 20 Sept 2026](https://seedtable.com/companies/fluxco/changelog "When we last updated or re-verified this profile — view the changelog & sources") Fluxco is an Austin, Texas-based company that runs an AI-powered procurement platform for electrical grid equipment. Founded in 2025 by former investor Brian Tochman after he repeatedly watched energy and infrastructure projects stall on transformer shortages, it parses complex utility transformer specifications and matches them against competitive bids from more than 150 global OEMs within days, then handles leasing, logistics and servicing end to end. The company raised a $26 million seed round co-led by 8VC and Congruent Ventures in 2026, with Trust Ventures and Overture Ventures participating.
